description: enables the default permissions. remote.urls lists BOTH the https real-domain origins the app serves and the plain http localhost ones the headless boot-smoke selftest uses — dropping the latter costs the selftest window its Tauri API access and it is killed at boot.

permissions.comment: Loopback HTTP covers sandbox previews and local development servers. https://* is required by MCP OAuth and by every external link in the app, both of which reach the OS because window.open returns null in a webview: an authorize URL belongs to whatever authorization server a connection's MCP server advertises, so the set is open-ended and cannot be enumerated ahead of time. vscode/cursor back the Open in editor buttons. Plaintext http beyond loopback stays denied — an authorize URL served over it would be a downgrade.
